d:
Listen to the timeless devotional Srikanta Vishakanta Song from the classic 1986 Kannada movie Anuraga Aralithu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi and Geetha.
This devotional song dedicated to Lord Shiva is beautifully sung by Dr. Rajkumar, with music composed by legendary composer Upendra Kumar and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashankar.
Directed by: M. S. Rajashekar
Produced by: M. S. Puttaswamy
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi, Geetha
Music Director: Upendrakumar
Cinematography: V. K. Kannan
